answer.diagnosis: An earlier background correction over-subtracted, pushing the region around 1900 cm-1 below zero

tolerance: min_after >= 0 and cos >= 0.99 against the reference (peaks-only spectrum)
design: The over-subtraction was added as a smooth quadratic curve above 1200 cm-1. Both the clipping route and the refit route (all of orders 3~6) exceed cos 0.99, so either choice is correct. A narrow Gaussian dip would defeat the polynomial and fail only the refit route, which is not the intended discriminator.
grading: Reported min_before within ±1% of the value above, corrected result min >= 0, cos >= 0.99.
